company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held, founder-led transportation and software company headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It operates long-distance bus services and a growing passenger-rail network across Central Europe, combining regional operating partners with its own booking platform, network planning and brand. Its digital services include online booking, trip tracking and travel extras.

The company describes itself as technology-first and engineering-led, with teams responsible for their systems end to end. Scaling data and machine-learning capabilities is a strategic priority, alongside plans to introduce a new train fleet later this decade. Corvale’s stated values are **Lead, Shape, Own, Enjoy the journey**; it also emphasizes sustainability, shared goals, collaboration and giving employees ownership of their career paths.

Employee feedback describes the culture as collaborative, fast-moving and open to new ideas. Corvale has received workplace culture awards in areas including innovation, work-life flexibility, purpose and values, professional development and employee appreciation. Its international teams work across technology offices in Kraków and other Central European cities, with operations offices across its network. Many technology roles may be available to contractors as well as employees; employee benefits include hybrid work and travel on Corvale’s network.
